webhooks.detail: Repo/org/app webhooks and GitHub App webhooks subscribe to many event types (push, pull_request, issues, etc.) delivered via HTTP POST.

evidence.quote: Webhooks let you subscribe to events happening in a software system and automatically receive a delivery of data to your server whenever those events occur.

sandbox.detail: Free GitHub account (GitHub Free) works for testing; create free test repos/orgs/apps. No separate sandbox needed.

evidence.quote: GitHub offers free and paid plans for storing and collaborating on code.

rate_limits.summary: REST primary limit: 60 req/hr unauthenticated; 5,000 req/hr authenticated users (higher for apps/Enterprise); plus secondary limits; GraphQL separate point-based limit

evidence.quote: The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour.
GitHub maintains official Octokit libraries for some languages.
GitHub's OpenAPI description of the REST API is publicly available.
